interpretation.negative_signature: The intensity failures are finite-template off-support mass and a late support collapse; the two-broad endpoint fails the analytic projected CDF despite passing coarser mass/width gates. Descriptive nearest-group output recentering identifies a location contribution, not an optimizer cause.
interpretation.original_vs_study: Original COMPLETE/PASS at lr .006375/prior1 remains original PASS. Acquisition confirmed at update500 leaves four passing post-confirmation checks, fewer than the study requires; no budget extension was made.
interpretation.unknown: The three native100, unequal-mass, anisotropic and bars4 cases were never reached. No whole eight-case configuration or defaults recommendation is qualified.
interpretation.causal_limit: These saved-cloud signatures do not establish why the optimizer or policy produced them. A same-seed coefficient grid is not a mechanistic intervention proof.
interpretation.sampling: Output noise is disabled in these served observations; public latent perturbation remains active. These are not unperturbed finite-atom serving laws.
interpretation.scope_limit: Provisional eight-case API policy screen; no Forge MoG, all-toy, calibration, reserved robustness or speed qualification.

media_visual_review.scope: All five decoded GIFs: first, middle and terminal frame visually reviewed; all nine frames counted by the strict verifier.
media_visual_review.labels: The permanent Default test label shows the original receipt verdict, not the additional study hold status. The prior1/.006375 GIF correctly displays original PASS; its study remains INCOMPLETE. The prior2/.0085 GIF correctly displays original FAIL despite final instantaneous PASS.
media_visual_review.limitation: The two-broad movie illustrates global coverage, nearest-component mass and local width. Its abbreviated metric text does not show the terminal analytic CDF bound; the linked receipt and compact report supply that failure.
